target_formalization.claim: the sum of the first n odd numbers equals n squared, for every natural number n
target_formalization.formal_statement: theorem wit_sum_odds (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (2 * i + 1) = n ^ 2

target_protection.original_statement: the sum of the first n odd numbers equals n squared, for every natural number n

lemma_plan.statement: the empty sum equals zero squared, which is the base case
if the identity holds at k then it holds at k plus one
lemma_plan.method: peeling the last term off the sum and using the hypothesis

formalization.type: ∀ k : ℕ, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (2 * i + 1) = k ^ 2) → ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (2 * i + 1) = (k + 1) ^ 2
formalization.tactic:
intro k ih
rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
ring
